title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 02
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: khách sạn, sửa chữa, tuyển dụng, sự kiện, bán lẻ, ngân hàng; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript:
W: Good morning. I have a reservation under the name Ana Duarte. I know check-in isn't until three, but is there any chance my room is ready?
M: Let me check, Ms. Duarte. I'm afraid the housekeeping staff are still cleaning it. It should be ready around one o'clock.
W: That's fine. I have a business meeting nearby at eleven anyway. Could I leave my suitcase here until then?
M: Of course. I'll give you a claim ticket, and we'll keep it in our storage room. And while you wait, our café on the second floor offers hotel guests a free coffee.

questions.content: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explanation: Khách có đặt phòng, hỏi nhận phòng sớm, nhân viên nhắc 'housekeeping', 'hotel guests' → khách sạn.

questions.content: Why is the woman's room not available?

options.B: It has been given to another guest.
options.D: Her reservation is for the next day.

questions.explanation: 'The housekeeping staff are still cleaning it' → phòng đang được dọn.

questions.content: What does the man offer the woman?
questions.explanation: 'Our café on the second floor offers hotel guests a free coffee' → đồ uống miễn phí (coffee → beverage).

options.D: A contract has not been signed.

questions.content: What does Leila suggest?

questions.content: What will Kate most likely do next?

options.A: Ask a printer about paper options

groups.transcript:
M: Hello, this is Greg Tan. I dropped off my laptop at your store for repair on May third, and I haven't heard anything since.
W: Let me look up your order, Mr. Tan. It says here that we had to order a replacement screen from the manufacturer.
M: I was told it would take about five days. It's been two weeks.
W: I'm very sorry about that. The part arrived this morning, so a technician can install it today. We'll also waive the repair fee because of the delay.
M: Thank you. When can I pick it up?
W: It should be ready by six this evening. I'll send you a text message when it's done.

questions.content: Why is the man calling?

options.D: To check on the status of a repair

questions.explanation: Anh gửi máy sửa từ ngày 3/5 mà 'haven't heard anything since' → gọi hỏi tình trạng sửa chữa.

questions.content: Why does the man say, "It's been two weeks"?

options.B: To complain that a job is taking too long
options.C: To explain why he needs a receipt

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: được hứa khoảng 5 ngày mà đã hai tuần → phàn nàn việc sửa quá lâu; nhân viên liền xin lỗi.

questions.content: What does the woman offer to do?

options.B: Give the man a replacement laptop

questions.explanation: 'We'll also waive the repair fee because of the delay' – miễn phí sửa chữa.

groups.transcript:

questions.content: Each applicant must provide two letters of ------- from previous employers.

Greenway Bike Shop Adds Repair Classes

LAKEVIEW (April 4) – Greenway Bike Shop on Center Street has begun offering evening classes that teach cyclists how to maintain and repair their own bicycles. The two-hour classes cover topics such as fixing flat tires, adjusting brakes, and cleaning chains.

"Many of our customers wanted to learn how to handle basic problems on their own," said owner Tony Marsh. "The classes also give people a chance to meet other cyclists in the area."

Classes are held on Tuesdays and Thursdays and cost $35 each. Participants receive a 10 percent discount on any tools purchased on the day of their class. Classes are limited to eight people so that everyone gets hands-on practice.
